description: Fires when the center column (column 3) holds exactly three stones and the top one (row 3 from the bottom) is the opponent's, strongest right after the opponent has just played it there, especially early in the game. It fades within a few plies if other moves follow, and is off when column 3 has 2 or 4+ stones or the top center stone is mine. Other columns do nothing.
effect: Small and inconsistent: forcing it high lowers the model's favorite move by up to about 0.25 (often column 2) and nudges column 3/4 up slightly; zeroing it changes probabilities by under 0.1.
notes: H1 (col 3 height 3, top theirs) F1 0.80, recall 0.99; adding recency (col-3 stone within last 3 plies) F1 0.886 (P 0.84, R 0.94), sim share 1.07. Window of 5 plies F1 0.86. Minimal pairs agree (top mine / height 2 or 4 kills it). Residual misses: weak firing (~2) when a 4th stone of mine just capped a col-3 stack whose row 2 is theirs. Synthesis peaks 9.87, below dev max 10.2.
